results.name: Wildfires in West Spain
results.reason: Since the second week of August 2025, several forest fires have affected the West Spain, impacting civil protection. This area included several towns and cities, major roads, and railways. Copernicus EMS Rapid Mapping was requested to provide initial rough estimation, wildfire extent and damage assessment emergency mapping.
results.activator: Spain|Ministry of Interior - Centro Nacional de Emergencias (CENEM) de la Direccion General de Proteccion Civil y Emergencias
